corpus_estimate.note: post-stratified by language (weights = live translated pages per language at draw time); languages outside the 15 sampled are not represented; CI = 95% bootstrap over pages-as-books within language

sensitivity.note: corrected estimates; see comment in score.mjs. "language" = the headline weighting; "language_x_arm" re-weights the quota-sampled arm to its true share; "page_weighted" weights each book by its translated pages (random page rather than random book)

worst.reason: the commentary and oration up to 'repressit: hic, qui se est' = source, but roughly a third of the output is a continuation of Pro Sestio imported from beyond the page
Translation renders a handful of fragments of the dower counts and replaces the rest with ellipses and a summarising note; adds a name not in the source.
Senju-Shigehira banquet scene loosely sketched with names wrong (Nobuhira, Kannon, Ono for Kitano), the sake cask turned into a lattice, and the rōei and its vow missing
Mostly faithful, but it reverses 'parum ... sollicite cogitet' into anxious thought and renumbers Ptolemy's four-point plan as three.
follows a garbled OCR of Seneca, De tranquillitate, sentence by sentence; several corrupt spans (clanis, vina imago, sub ducentibus) turned into confident but unsupported English

Heavily abbreviated OCR; the peculatus cases, monopolists and boundary-moving passages are recoverably rendered, but the sacrilege definition is altered and several garbled spans become confident prose; I read the abbreviations only partly.
Follows the garbled Kurrent OCR paragraph by paragraph, but smooths several unintelligible spans (Ooe/Oeder, oinum/Onosum, Diet) into confident readings; German alchemical OCR read moderately.

Follows the OCR sentence by sentence (Marcasite, vitriol extraction, faeces re-exposed, lye repeated, Hungarian ♄), but papers over several garbled Kurrent misreadings with fluent prose; German read well but the OCR is poor.

source is badly garbled astronomical Greek; translation follows it clause by clause with brackets, but misreads ς̅ as 60 and point labels as numbers; I read this kind of abbreviated Greek only moderately well
The five testimonia are rendered in substance, but the eta/epsilon point of fr. 36 is lost and the whole footnote apparatus (four notes, one explanatory) is missing.
Swaddling instructions otherwise = source, but inverts the reason for loosening at the loin for girls, drops the opening clause, and appends an invented sentence on wool padding past the page end.
Tracks the words of a badly garbled Greek column, but bridges the gaps with supplied notes into prose the source cannot support. My reading of the corrupt Greek is weak.
the prose on the pyramid bases = source, but the layer lists in the diagram are reassigned between Pair and Impair, and the notes add claims the source does not make
The spec line (1-chi flag, 1 zhang 5 chi spear, hung at 9 chi, 2 jin) is correct, but invented book/volume headings and background claims are added.
Recipes 23–27 and footnotes mostly right, but verse 21 reverses who touches whom and who is subjugated, and v.22 garble is smoothed; Sanskrit read moderately.

the case structure and Buddha's ruling are followed, but the key legal term is wrong throughout, the 'did not know for N months' clause is misread, and 'became ashamed' is imported into the later cases; my Tibetan is moderate

source is near-total OCR garble; translation honestly marks most of it <unclear> and glosses only scattered words, but stretches a few glosses and labels the page 'Drukpa Kagyu' biography without basis; low confidence in the Tibetan

Quintilian end of Book X and opening of XI De apte dicendo (Cicero's fourth virtue, men in necklaces, triumphal dress, De Oratore III, Crassus, Brutus) = source; only the opening fragment's 'deformat' softened to 'shaping'.
Psalms, antiphons, versicles, absolution and blessing all = source; appends the rest of the Ecclesiasticus 24 lesson plus 'Tu autem' that the page does not carry.
word-by-word literal rendering that keeps the garbled OCR's oddities ('perfected by sin', 'return consciousness') visible instead of smoothing them over; a few small slips
Long garbled-OCR Latin on the palm tracked closely throughout; slips on biduum ('two years'), lapidior ('more digestive'), and pla. as Plato
Commentary, argument and Caelius's letter all rendered closely, including textual variants; only slip is 'malis orbiculatis' (round apples) as 'round cakes'.
Pythagorean numbers, Scientia Mechanica, signatures, pondere mensura et ordine, harmony of seeds = source; invented context note and a slightly restructured conditional.
Kidney dissection passage (tunic, emulgent vessels, fissure, goose-foot branching) faithful apart from a reshaped clause on the fat
faithful account of Roman thermae, the emperors' bathing and the list of baths; drops the name Posthumius and flattens the 'some/others' distribution
